summary: Flash Sports & Media Holdings filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that its common stock moved to OTCID Markets under symbol FLZH on September 25, 2026, and that its OTCQB listing application is pending. The previously scheduled September 28, 2026 annual meeting was cancelled and will be rescheduled; a Nasdaq continued-listing hearing is set for October 6, 2026, following an August 21, 2026 disclosure. No price, stake, or board recommendation was provided. Watch the October 6 Nasdaq panel outcome and OTCQB approval as key catalysts and downside risks.
